title: Direction in GSEA

scenario.collection: Gene Ontology Biological Process teaching subset
scenario.ranking_metric: Welch t statistic, Group B minus Group A
scenario.positive_nes: genes in the set accumulate toward the Group B end of the ranking
scenario.negative_nes: genes in the set accumulate toward the Group A end of the ranking

fdr_family.boundary: all evaluable sets in this fixed GO teaching subset under the declared ranking and size limits

dotplot_contract.display_limit: up to the 30 pathways with lowest FDR

go_redundancy_context.interpretation: The related GO labels and shared leading-edge genes are overlapping evidence, not independent replication.

answer_key: Positive NES preserves the declared B minus A direction and therefore points toward Group B; negative NES points toward Group A. Neither result establishes pathway activation or causality.
interpretation_boundary: Enrichment is a ranked-set association and does not establish pathway activation or causality.
completion_rule: Completion depends on preserving contrast direction and the tested FDR family, never on significance.
